in_marathi.name: Shivpujan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Worship of Shiva
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shivpujan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Shivpujan is a combination of two words - Shiv and Pujan. Shiv refers to Lord Shiva, the Hindu god of destruction and creation. Pujan means worship or reverence. Thus, the name Shivpujan signifies the act of worshipping Lord Shiva.
